messages.subject: pooling of density values
parts:
Dear distance users,

Computation of density value with DISTANCE or other programs yields an
estimate and a log-normal interval of confidences. Sometime it is necessary
to pool together different surveys in order to compute the population
estimate of a larger area. I wonder how to sum-up confidence intervals.

Thanks in advance for your help.

best wishes,

messages.author: d718c6bb1db28db2
messages.subject: Re: pooling of density values
parts:
> > Computation of density value with DISTANCE or other programs yields an
> > estimate and a log-normal interval of confidences. Sometime it is necessary
> > to pool together different surveys in order to compute the population
> > estimate of a larger area. I wonder how to sum-up confidence intervals.

If you're adding estimates of abundance that are independently estimated,
their variances also add. You can then apply the formula for log-normal
confidence intervals given in the distance sampling book (which is on our
web pages) to these totals.

Steve Buckland
